title: Diagnose Docker and restore Medic Bridge relay (P1)
description: Docker engine appears down and the medic-bridge relay is unreachable. Diagnose and restore.
objectives: Report Docker engine status and container list
If Docker Desktop is stopped, start it
If medic-bridge container exists but stopped, start it
constraints: If container is missing, report and stop — do not rebuild without confirmation
Do not modify relay config, tokens, or Chrome extension
Report each step: found, attempted, result
